children: The Parisian Macao marks its 10th anniversary this week. Over the past decade, the integrated resort owned by Sands China has become a landmark on the Cotai Strip and demonstrated Sands China's
confidence in Macau's long-term growth. In celebration of the property's 10th anniversary, Sands China
said it has curated a range of experiences to share with team members and all sectors of society.

The Parisian Macao is a French-themed integrated casino resort on Macau’s Cotai Strip, developed by Las Vegas Sands (now Sands China). Construction on the French-themed integrated casino resort began in February 2013 after a delay from its original 2015 target. The property opened to the public on September 13, 2016. Its signature feature is a half-scale Eiffel Tower replica, alongside Paris-inspired hotel, retail, dining, entertainment, and casino spaces. It was Sands China's

fifth Macau-region property and completed the company’s interconnected Cotai resort cluster. In 2019, it converted 600 hotel rooms into 300 suites, reducing its total room inventory from about 3K to roughly 2.7K. Since its inception, The Parisian Macao has attracted more than 100M visitors from around the world.

Over the past 10 years, Sands China has continued to invest in and enrich The Parisian Macao's non-gaming offerings. The property now boasts over 2,540 hotel rooms, approximately 62K square feet of MICE facilities, and the 1.2K-seat Parisian Theatre. Shoppes at Parisian, covering approximately 297K square feet, has brought the Macao debut of many international fashion brands, further enriching the city's retail and tourism experience. The resort also features family-friendly facilities such as Qube Kingdom and Aqua World.
